description.p: triM. is a modern, fast, and native non-linear video editor designed for Linux. Built natively with Rust, egui, and FFmpeg, it offers a focused workflow for video cutting, multi-track editing, audio mixing, and exporting.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline with ripple edits, snapping, and frame-accurate navigation
Real-time preview monitor with live stereo audio VU metering
Interactive fade handles, picture-in-picture transformations, and color adjustments
Title and text generation with typography controls

screenshot.caption: Subtitle Suite and Smart Scene Cut Detection
9:16 Vertical Shorts/Reels Canvas with Safe Zones
Multi-channel Audio Mixer and Equalizer Controls
GPU Hardware-Accelerated Export Studio and Loudness Normalization

description.p: triM. v1.0.0 is the first major production milestone! Featuring a complete native non-linear video editing workflow: interactive on-screen Type tool (T) with real-time viewport text placement and automatic timeline clip generation, multi-NLE keyboard shortcut profiles (triM., Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), CMX 3600 EDL and Final Cut Pro XML sequence interoperability, 3-point interactive Color Wheels (Lift, Gamma, Gain), real-time Chroma Key green screen compositor, Ken Burns Pan & Zoom motion presets, Subtitle Suite (.SRT/.VTT), Smart Scene Detection, timeline voiceover recording, 4K Smart Proxy workflow, and GPU-accelerated export.

triM. v0.6.0 adds Subtitle Suite (.SRT/.VTT) import and export, Smart Scene Detection auto-cut using FFmpeg scene score, 3D LUT support (.cube) with cinematic color grading presets (Teal & Orange, Vintage Film, Monochrome Noir, Cyberpunk Neon), Live Timeline Voiceover recording directly on audio tracks, Smart Proxy workflow for smooth 4K/UHD playback, and dynamic Keyboard Shortcut Profiles (triM. Default, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve).

triM. v0.5.0 adds GPU hardware-accelerated exports (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, Linux VAAPI), 9:16 vertical Shorts/Reels canvas mode with interactive Safe Zones guides, EBU R128 loudness normalization, Voice Clarity and Podcast EQ presets with Noise Gate, real-time Live Titler and subtitle generator, and standalone portable project archiving.

triM. v0.4.0 represents a complete transition to 100% native Rust, a redesigned 4-quadrant NLE interface, an 8-tool vector editing toolbar, track audio mixer, Export Studio presets, cross-platform standard paths, and native Windows support with silent process execution and one-line installers.
triM. v0.3.0 introduces timeline markers with magnetic snapping, keyframe animation for transform and opacity properties, and variable clip playback speed and reverse.
triM. v0.2.0 introduces multi-clip selection and batch manipulation, track mixer with mute/solo controls, audio detach workflow, and Q/W ripple trim shortcuts.
